assumptions.statement: Official redline, key-area polygons, FAR, height, tenure, municipal capacity and road redlines are not in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All areas are design-model values on provisional geometry and must be recomputed after official data arrives.

assumptions.statement: The heritage park is treated as an already-built ground plane, not a new monumental axis.
assumptions.impact: Spatial emphasis is placed on vias, dual clocks and replaceable userspace services.
